title: EXP-108 - Hello World Part 7 Section 6a: FlexLayout FlexLayoutFooter (Theme Class FX_BlueBackground) in the root footer Region and FlexLayout FlexLayoutMain in the root main Region of FX_CustomerPortal; Default Attributes of FlexLayoutMain Read; Readback After Reopen
objective: Follow hello-world-pt7.md Section 6 steps 1-3 (08:51-09:11) on the User-scope Form FX_CustomerPortal: place one FlexLayout from the Toolbox into the root FlexLayout's footer region, name it FlexLayoutFooter and set Theme Class FX_BlueBackground, one Designer Save; then place one FlexLayout into the root main region, name it FlexLayoutMain, one Designer Save, and record its default attributes read-only (input for EXP-109, which configures its six regions). Task boundary: do only what the current task instruction lists and stop at its end, even when later steps of this brief remain; report the next step instead of performing it.

Server-event rule (EXP-103-R2 lesson): if any action raises 'The server event processing returned an error', answer OK once, record it and stop blocked for an operator Designer reload; never try another route, retry, close or reopen after that error.

Designer gate (read-only except at most one reopen): User scope; FX_CustomerPortal open and clean (Save disabled), no dialog open; if it is not open, open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry (never Select Form OK). Record the Components tree (Pane (00) > flexlayoutPane_FX_CustomerPortal > Region00: header > FlexLayoutHeader with StaticHeader, StaticCustIcon and StaticCustID; Region01: main and Region02: footer, both empty) and where the main region (the large middle area between the dotted dividers) and the footer region (the narrow strip below the lower dotted divider; scroll the canvas if needed, view only) lie on the canvas.

Efficiency rules (operator, 2026-10-16): screenshots only for the decisive states named in this brief; do not re-open saved images unless a decision needs it; one untargeted snapshot per step; read only the named sources; never search or read the worker's own session transcript.

Placement rule (EXP-105): click the FlexLayout row in the Toolbox once, then click once inside the target region on the canvas, away from edges, dividers and other components' adorner icons. Immediately record the Components tree: the new FlexLayout must be a direct child of the named root region. If it was placed anywhere else, click the toolbar Undo once, record the state and stop blocked. Never use mouse dragging. Name is a plain text editor (double-click the value cell, one plain fill, Tab; at most one correction); Theme Class is an ExtJS combobox (open the list, click the option, Tab). The Properties header may lag after a rename (EXP-105); reselect once by the Components row if needed.

Footer (T2): place one FlexLayout into the root footer region (Region02: footer) by the placement rule, set Name FlexLayoutFooter and Appearance > Theme Class FX_BlueBackground (record the classes listed). If FX_BlueBackground is not listed, record the list, Undo the placement once and stop blocked before Save. Then exactly one Designer Save with its response, the Save state and the canvas (expected: a blue footer strip). Screenshots: placement with the tree, Save response.

Main (T3): place one FlexLayout into the root main region (Region01: main) by the placement rule and set Name FlexLayoutMain (no Theme Class; the tutorial sets none). Then exactly one Designer Save with its response and the Save state. Then, read-only: with FlexLayoutMain selected (reselect by its Components row if needed), open Edit FlexLayout Attributes once through its canvas adorner (hover first; identify it by the tooltip 'Edit FlexLayout Attributes' or its flexlayouteditadorner DOM id, not by position) and record Type, Auto Size, Region Index, Margin, the region count and each region's ID, Length, Unit, Orientation, Alignment, Pack, Minimum and Maximum Length and Default Margin. Open no list; change nothing; Cancel once; verify Save is still disabled. Screenshots: placement with the tree, Save response, the dialog.

Readback and audit (T4, one task): close the clean FX_CustomerPortal once through its Form-tab control (answer No to any save prompt, record its text), reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry, record the Components tree (FlexLayoutFooter under Region02: footer, FlexLayoutMain under Region01: main, the header components unchanged), select FlexLayoutFooter and FlexLayoutMain by their Components rows and record Name, Type and Theme Class, and record the canvas. Leave the Form open and clean. Then, in the same task, write the documentation-only final audit into the record: decisive evidence for each acceptance check, the cumulative action audit with exact counts, the worker-written-file inventory, the cleanup inventory and the final state. Screenshots: the reopened tree and canvas.

Before every click, use references from the most recent snapshot taken in the current task (not from find output); after any timeout or 'Ref not found', take one fresh untargeted snapshot and use only its references. Coordinates are allowed only for the two canvas placement clicks and FlexLayoutMain's canvas adorner when no reference exists; record each such click. Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. Classify findings as observed only.
